en.headline: Police arrest 147 in triad syndicate linked to HK$600 million laundering
en.dek: A citywide operation code-named Rapidhorse dismantled an alleged triad network running drug dens and illegal gambling, with officers seizing cash, jewellery and weapons after tracing criminal proceeds through puppet accounts.
body: Hong Kong police arrested 147 people in a two-day citywide operation code-named Rapidhorse against a triad-linked syndicate suspected of laundering more than HK$600 million in proceeds from drug trafficking and illegal gambling.

The Organised Crime and Triad Bureau said the operation, conducted on 7 and 8 August with undercover support, dismantled 14 illegal premises including a puppet-account coordination centre, a money-laundering centre, four drug dens and eight gambling dens. Among those arrested were 93 men and 54 women aged 19 to 72; 31 were believed to have triad backgrounds. The alleged ringleader, a 56-year-old man described as a senior figure in a West Kowloon triad society, was among those detained.

Police seized about HK$3.65 million in cash together with jewellery, luxury watches, vehicles, bank cards, weapons, gambling equipment and drugs with a total estimated value of around HK$5 million. Bank records showed the syndicate had used multiple puppet accounts between January 2025 and August 2026 to process the illicit funds. All arrestees were detained for further inquiries; some have already been charged with operating a gambling establishment or a drug den.

zh.headline: O記搗三合會洗黑錢集團拘147人 涉逾6億元
zh.dek: 警方代號「捷駒」行動搗破懷疑三合會集團經營毒窟及賭檔，利用傀儡戶口清洗逾6億元犯罪得益，拘捕包括主腦在內共147人。
body: 警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科過去兩日展開代號「捷駒」的全港行動，搗破一個懷疑三合會背景的犯罪集團，拘捕147人，涉嫌透過經營毒窟及非法賭檔獲利，並利用傀儡戶口清洗逾6億元犯罪得益。
行動於8月7日及8日進行，動員臥底探員，共搜查14個非法場所，包括一個傀儡戶口統籌中心、一個洗黑錢中心、4個毒窟及8個賭檔。被捕者包括93男54女，年齡介乎19至72歲，其中31人懷疑有三合會背景；被捕主腦為一名56歲男子，據報屬西九龍某三合會叔父輩人物。
警方檢獲約365萬元現金，以及金飾、名錶、車輛、銀行卡、武器、賭具及毒品等，總值約500萬元。銀行紀錄顯示集團於2025年1月至2026年8月期間，利用多個傀儡戶口處理黑錢。所有被捕人士現正扣查，部分人已被控經營賭場或煙窟等罪名。
